in_marathi.name: Lalsingh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Lalsingh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Lal: God, Singh: Lion. The name Lalsingh signifies one who is a servant of God, and as a lion represents courage and strength, this name is a powerful symbol of devotion and bravery.

in_bengali.name: Lalsingh
